scripts.docs:check: npm run docs:lint && npm --workspace @medicore/docs-tools run check
scripts.api:bundle: npm run api:source && redocly bundle contracts/openapi/openapi.yaml --output contracts/openapi/medicore.openapi.yaml
scripts.api:check: npm run api:bundle && npm run api:lint && node tools/openapi/check-inventory.mjs
scripts.frontend:lint: npm --prefix patient run lint && npm --prefix control_center run lint
scripts.frontend:typecheck: npm --prefix patient run typecheck && npm --prefix control_center run typecheck
scripts.frontend:build: npm --prefix patient run build && npm --prefix control_center run build
scripts.verify: npm run docs:check && npm run docs:render && npm run api:check && npm run patient:typecheck && npm run patient:build
